Anti xiangqi: every engine game, and the opening table

Every game behind the write-up, replayed by the rule kernel as referee, and the opening chain as a table. Arrow keys step a game once a widget has focus. Notation is chess-style: R chariot, H horse, E elephant, A advisor, K general, C cannon, P soldier; files a to i from Red's left, ranks 1 to 10 from Red's side. The three best-play games are shown as their mirror images (the engine opened 1. Cxh10) so their files match the rest.
